headings.instruction: Do not use Inter/Roboto. Use Outfit for all headings. Ensure tight tracking for headings > 32px for a premium modern geometric look.

body.instruction: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for high legibility, clean structure, and premium feel.

colors.instruction: Strictly NO dark-theme dominance. Black is only for very minimal accents or primary typography. Environment must feel bright, airy, and premium.

surfaces.card: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-50 hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgb(0,0,0,0.06)] transition-shadow duration-300

motion.philosophy: Smooth, elegant, unobtrusive. Fast but graceful.

framer_motion.page_load: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
framer_motion.cart_badge: initial={{ scale: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1 }} transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 500, damping: 15 }}

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12 for sections. Container max-w-7xl mx-auto.
layouts.hero: Split layout: Left content (eyebrow, massive H1, description, dual CTAs). Right floating hardware composition with subtle parallax and orange geometric accents.
layouts.product_grid: Grid cols-1 sm:cols-2 lg:cols-4 gap-8. High quality images on warm white background.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar nav, Top bar. Grid cols-1 md:cols-3 lg:cols-4 gap-6. Dense but readable. Sharp/minimal radius.

component_instructions.header: Premium Header. Top bar (thin, promos). Main header (Logo, large search bar, wishlist, cart, account). Sticky on scroll with glassmorphism.
component_instructions.product_card: White background, subtle border. Image takes 70% height. Hover: image slight zoom, 'Add to Cart' button slides up or fades in. Wishlist heart top-right.
component_instructions.buttons: Primary: Pill-shaped or rounded-full, solid brand_orange, white text. Secondary: White bg, border brand_orange, orange text or dark text.
component_instructions.product_details: Left: Large sticky gallery with thumbnails. Right: Title, price, specs, quantity, massive Add to Cart. Smooth scrolling to reviews.

media.instructions: Use these exact URLs for products, categories, backgrounds, and logos. Never use dummy text placeholders for images.

icons.instruction: Use lucide-react. Keep stroke width thin (1.5) for a premium, delicate look matching the high-end hardware.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure brand_orange on white meets at least 3:1 for large text and 4.5:1 for small. If using orange background, use white text.
accessibility.motion: Wrap framer-motion configs with useReducedMotion hook where applicable or ensure structural usability without animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Text reads naturally left-aligned.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical for a premium breathable look.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-white/80 for sticky headers. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds over content.
Include data-testid on all key interactive elements.
